rv.q: Mr. Lutken brings a quiet stoicism to his role that becomes powerfully moving as Edgar admits the pain his mistakes have caused.
A family drama brimming with heart and music, The Porch on Windy Hill is the kind of play that leaves you with hope that the things that divide us might be bridged by the bridge of a good song.
The actors are also all expert musicians, and they provide a toe-tapping, infectious good night at the theater.

cn.t: Critics warmly embrace this folk music-infused family drama, praising its affecting story of reconciliation and the cast's performance of traditional American songs that create an intimate sense of memory and community.

vr.q: The Porch on Windy Hill was an enjoyable time in the theater. The music, the performances, the intimate setting really carried you through, but it can be confusing at times due to pacing and character motivations.
